changes: Add optional SpillAdapter.stageWrite with explicit commit/rollback lifecycle; legacy adapters remain valid.
Implement staged writes in MemorySpillAdapter, leaving published data readable until commit and checking the observed entry version before replacement.
Include pending payloads in spill capacity/usage; stage replacement requires capacity for old and new payload overlap.
Make rollback and successful repeated commit idempotent; rolled-back writes cannot commit. Track version identity separately from payload so transactions do not pin overwritten buffers.

cases: staging overlap rejection preserves existing entry
competing staged commit conflict preserves winner

remaining: Query/window checkpoint writers do not yet use staged writes; cancellation cleanup integration remains open.
Other spill adapters need explicit staging/conditional-write capabilities or documented legacy behavior.
Multi-run window checkpoint commit/rollback and failures during commit need full lifecycle validation.
No claim that adapter payload accounting is a total heap cap.
